exposure: trial of labor after two cesarean section (TOLA2C)
cohort: 793 women with a vertex singleton gestation at term and a history of two prior cesarean sections
finding: There was no difference in maternal or neonatal morbidity between women with two previous cesarean sections who underwent TOLA2C versus ERCD.
mod_finding: There was no difference in maternal or neonatal morbidity among women with two previous cesarean sections who opted for TOLA2C versus ERCD.
